4279-5931-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5931-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6073-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6073-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2527-3143-3464-4247.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-4247.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2896-3899-5145.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

728-3585-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-647-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-5931-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

2557-4772-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-4772-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

5627-6517-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
5627-6517-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

1020-4659-7714.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
When Myr Retriever enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Myr Retriever.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr Retriever token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Myr Retriever token dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-2438-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

1368-4289-6321-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-6321-6965.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2104-2974-5131.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2104-2974-5131.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4762-7061.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Solid Ground.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

240-803-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-5231.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1061-4603-6633.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
You control at least nine permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-4603-6633.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-6633.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.
Activate The Fire Crystal by paying {4}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token will give you the city's blessing.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

104-1308-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-1308-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

57-3480-4235-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3480-4235-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

104-2034-3490-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-4268.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-4499-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-4499-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-5477-6968.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

700-3174-3862.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand and controls a creature.
700-3174-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-3174-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

1575-3698-6748.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

7-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-4484-4871-5147-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2961-5256-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2961-5256-6553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1754-4766-5683-5686.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-4766-5683-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

570-579-1636-1806-5769.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one permanent of each color.
570-579-1636-1806-5769.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Legacy Weapon by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
When Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1844-3221-3283.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least four.
1844-3221-3283.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {2}{U}{B}, causing you to draw four cards and give control of Notion Thief to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1652-2034-2136-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
1652-2034-2136-5200.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Patron of the Arts with haste.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Patron of the Arts tokens, adding six {C}.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens die, they trigger, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control.

3363-4067.description:
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and then causing you to draw a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat.

1528-1878-3360.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to Torchling.
Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
1528-1878-3360.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Torchling by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1462-3560.description:
Cast Archon of Sun's Grace by paying its mana cost.
When Archon of Sun's Grace enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Archon of Sun's Grace's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat step 3.
